purpose: Authoritative independent geometry for the reusable L2 paired fan, with native north collars and symmetric oblique lower connections matching the retained mainline diverge geometry.

metadata.name: HSR L2 Compact Paired Fan Join
metadata.description: Two opposite-direction flat L2 fan arms join the native paired north mouth to matched oblique mainline branches, using the Short Mainline Diverge Core angles and six explicitly owned supports.
metadata.provenance: Authorized trumpet-angle redesign: retained native north mouth and game identities; symmetric arms share the unchanged Short Mainline Diverge Core branch angles; software geometry only.

surface_context.purpose: Complete literal sweep context for only the two coordinated fan arms. The native mainline and southern merge surfaces, footprints, and train-clearance polygons end strictly south of this module's owned boundary and are excluded. The retained fan arms preserve their full lower joining context; the compiler emits only their eleven owned tiles.

angle_redesign.purpose: Record the authorized junction-angle redesign; these software measurements do not establish game operation.
angle_redesign.preservation: The fan retains only its two complete northern-arm sweep contexts; the excluded mainline and southern-merge backgrounds have no surface or clearance area inside its owned tiles. The opposing merge retains its own original mainline and southern direct-slip decks in both revised and retained compilation contexts.
